description: This file defines the NotEqualBinary class, which extends AbstractBinary and provides logic for compiling a 'not equal' binary expression within the Twig templating engine. It includes compatibility handling for different PHP versions.

classes.name: NotEqualBinary
classes.description: A class representing a 'not equal' binary expression node in the Twig abstract syntax tree. It handles compilation of the node into PHP code, considering PHP version differences.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'not equal' binary expression node into PHP code, using different approaches based on PHP version.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representing the operator ('!=') for this binary expression.
